motivation: Previous post-outcome t20 assurance-locus mosaic predicted a stronger within-model survival contrast than the two other loci under K8; validation needs entirely NEW pre20 donor histories and independently generated post20 ecological innovations.
transparency: Biological model, resource setting and focal locus were chosen AFTER previous model results; this is a prospective replication within ONE fixed simulator, not a preregistered new model family or an empirical island generalization.

history_design.independence: Source and future visitor RNG seeds are disjoint from all earlier PR452 cohorts. The same original eight founder genotypes are fixed across histories for genetic-source control; independent visitor and demographic RNG histories supply stochastic replication.
history_design.source_state_t0: original Model3 eight diploid founder plants from fixed seed 61024981 with standing variation at all 3 loci; same founding genotypes under selected and neutral parentage
history_design.eligible_if: both selected and neutral parentage source populations alive at t20; no donor substitution for extinct sources; report all 192 admission and exclusion histories
history_design.future_visitor_policy: Use completely new visitor-history RNG seed per source history, with inherited visitor composition at donor t20; random arrivals and losses over years20..79 generated independently of source/previous cohorts
history_design.future_demographic_seed_coupling: Identical future RNG seed across all mosaic-arm, genome-draw and K within the same source environmental history. Source RNG histories independent across 192 source indices.

hypotheses.primary: At recipient K8, selected-assurance-locus only versus neutral-all genome origin increases 80-update unconditional post-transplant occupancy by >0.05 absolute probability.
null_and_falsifiers: No clear positive response in new source donors
Beneficial response only in original exposed donor states
Matching/investment locus source explains equal or greater survival than assurance source
Strong genome resampling sensitivity leads to inconclusive cluster inference
Multiple-study transfer under this source model does not imply evolutionary suicide
secondary: two-order descriptive allele block allocation and interaction
hypotheses.exclude: No post-outcome switch of primary to best-looking K/gate/assurance setting

inference.unit: one newly generated source visitor history, restricted after original paired-survival eligibility; two whole-genome draws nested. Future visitor innovation independent across source history, not a separate donor replicate.
inference.primary_estimand: mean over eligible new source histories of per-history mean across two genotype draws of [N80>0 under selected-assurance-only - N80>0 under neutral-all], K8; conditioning on survival of both donor source arms at t20
inference.uncertainty_primary: 2999 cluster bootstrap percentile resamples of eligible source history IDs AND simultaneous distribution-free two-sided Hoeffding 95% bound on per-source bounded [-1,1] effects
inference.significance: Positive only if BOTH interval lower bounds >+0.05; negative only if BOTH upper bounds <−0.05; equivalence only if both wholly within ±0.05. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No output-based sample-size changes.
inference.secondary_intervals: descriptive 2999 source-cluster bootstrap, conservative Hoeffding bounds, no family-wise claim of independently confirmed secondary conditions
inference.stop: exactly 192 source histories from predeclared RNG range, no extension based on outcomes; every failed and ineligible t20 original source retained. No forced minimum number eligible.

scientific_boundaries: Fresh within-model source ecological histories but founding genotypes and the model's biology shared; no independent ecological-model families or natural Izu populations.
Conditional on both source genotypes surviving t20, so it cannot identify total evolution-enabled versus frozen effect on unconditional from-t0 extinction.
Selected/neutral pre20 source operators differ in within-channel inheritance, not a complete freeze of genetic change; drift present.
Whole-locus mosaics combine source genealogies artificially and affect mean/variance/allele-origin/covariance, not a pure assurance-locus mean.
No deleterious load: fixed inbreeding depression, zero mutation, no purging or evolving mutation load.
The model-observed association of selected assurance source and persistence would not establish evolutionary suicide; test evaluates putative rescue-oriented direction.
